conditionPolicy: Existing importer excludes activated, preactivated, demo and damaged packaging offers; ordinary offers are not repriced from those rows.
absencePolicy: Existing prices and stock not represented by this feed are preserved.
availabilityPolicy: Existing stock preserved except the explicitly approved preparation options; those are made available when their current supplier row receives a price.
dataSafety: Read-only by default. --apply requires the exact reviewed source hash; all catalog preparations and prices share a Serializable transaction, a private before snapshot, and post-write checks. Any unresolved matching stops the entire write.
databaseVerification: Not performed locally; run the deployment command on the owner-operated server.
